# Status contexts required by branch protection on main, one per line.
#
# This list is a local mirror of the remote branch protection configuration and
# exists only so a workflow change that renames or drops a required job is
# caught before merge; the remote configuration remains authoritative and is
# changed separately. Refresh it from the branch protection API when the remote
# list changes.
#
# The "CodeQL" context is reported by the CodeQL GitHub App rather than by a
# workflow job name, so it is not listed here.
#
# Verified against the branch protection API for this repository:
#   Lint GitHub Actions workflows
#   Quality gates
#   Analyze (javascript-typescript, actions)
#   CodeQL
